text: Owner decision 2026-10-09: 1.0 ships fixation-level AOI visits. A visit survives saccades, blinks and other non-member support between consecutive contained fixations (matches eyesim and the AOI literature). The current sample-level measure is kept under an explicit name (sample runs) so the convention is stated in a name, not a comment (design rule 8). Implementation: code + AoiLaws 'blocks' law change + PARITY note. Stays open as implementation work.
